senses.sense_definition: A military unit consisting of thirty to forty soldiers, typically led by a lieutenant and forming part of a company.

examples.text: The <w>platoon</w> moved silently through the dense forest during the night mission.
Every soldier in the <w>platoon</w> was required to clean their equipment before the inspection.

senses.sense_definition: A subdivision of a fire department company, led by a captain or lieutenant.

examples.text: The fire chief assigned a <w>platoon</w> to handle the emergency response in the downtown district.
Each <w>platoon</w> works a specific shift to ensure the station is always staffed.

senses.sense_definition: A group of self-driving vehicles traveling in a close convoy and communicating electronically.

examples.text: The autonomous trucks formed a <w>platoon</w> to improve fuel efficiency on the highway.
Engineers are testing how a <w>platoon</w> of cars reacts to sudden traffic changes.

senses.sense_definition: A group of children organized within a specific educational system.

examples.text: The school uses a <w>platoon</w> system to rotate students between different specialized classrooms.
Each <w>platoon</w> of students follows a unique schedule throughout the academic day.

senses.sense_definition: To alternate players based on their handedness relative to the opposing pitcher.

examples.text: The manager decided to <w>platoon</w> his outfielders to gain a statistical advantage.
They often <w>platoon</w> players when facing a strong left-handed starting pitcher.

senses.sense_definition: To specialize in a specific position or playing style in a team sport.

examples.text: Modern football teams frequently <w>platoon</w> players to keep them fresh for the entire game.
In the past, players did not <w>platoon</w> and had to play both offense and defense.

senses.sense_definition: For self-driving vehicles to travel in a close, electronically linked convoy.

examples.text: The fleet of trucks will <w>platoon</w> across the state to reduce wind resistance.
These vehicles are designed to <w>platoon</w> safely at high speeds on major roads.
